summary: App should display monthly totals and remove all goal-related fields across the entire UI.

existing_features.title: Remove all goal-related labels and values from each habit row so the habit info cell never shows a "Goal" line and the monthly total area never renders a "/ Goal: …" segment; only show the monthly total value.

Update the habit edit modal to remove goal-related UI: do not show any field labeled "Monthly Goal" and do not allow editing/storing a per-month goal value. The volume input should only appear for unit types that use per-completion volume ("reps" and "time"); for all other unit types, hide the volume input entirely.

Ensure all habit-related screens/components in the app contain no goal-related copy or UI remnants (e.g., "Goal:", "Monthly Goal"), including empty/zero values, and that monthly totals remain visible wherever they are currently shown.

new_feature_requests.summary: Remove all goal-related fields everywhere in the app and show only monthly totals

projectName: Remove all goal-related UI and show only monthly totals
